title: Terminal Ctrl+V paste claim conflicts with readline literal-next; no replacement binding added
context: xterm maps Ctrl+V to SYN (literal-next). Windows terminals expect Ctrl+V or Ctrl+Shift+V for paste. Choice is required.
decision: Claim Ctrl+V and Ctrl+Shift+V for paste. Do not add replacement binding for literal-next. Readline already has Ctrl+Q as fallback.
consequences: Paste works like Windows terminal users expect. Literal-next still available. Only AltGr is excluded to avoid breaking non-US keyboard layouts.
